annotation.coverageReview: Actually inspected all six original survey views, individual original front and final four-patch front/side overlays. One Jerboa head, long upright ears, dark eyes/nose, cream muzzle and black mouth/chin above navy scarf. Expanded side-jaw sphere covers enough source and sparse battle cheek geometry. Ear tips, forepaws, legs, neck cloth and long curled pompom tail require full-body review.

source.detail: All 24 enlarged source and battle front/side head/body slices actually inspected for 13 clips and six phases. Cream muzzle, black nose and chin stay rounded during attack, recoil, entrance and death; the former stretched black chin wedge is gone. Long ears, forepaws, hind legs and feet remain joined, with a continuous curled tail and pale tuft. Scarf folds independently without pulling cheeks; no new body seams or spikes seen.

productionTransitions.label: independent-rare-040-044-final-runtime-low
productionTransitions.detail: All 32 low/medium source/battle head/body transition slices and six native companion idle sheets actually inspected. Rounded cheeks and chin remain stable through nods, strike, recoil, death and revive; no stretched black wedge returns. Scarf motion is separate. Ears, forepaws, rear feet and curled tufted tail remain joined through all transitions. No spikes or new seams seen. Native idle face remains stable.

companionVisualReview.scope: Unchanged production companion component with local final battle asset, 24 advancing idle frames.

secondVisualPass.scope: All 24 enlarged repeated source/battle raw front/side face/body slices, all 32 enlarged low/mobile and medium/desktop production runtime slices and all six native companion sheets actually inspected. Repairs also received candidate visual inspection.

region.finding: All 13 original animations visually inspected in complete front/side head and body sheets. Polecat lower cheeks and mouth flatten in the turned defeat pose.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle front/side head/body slices, 13 clips at six phases. Large eyes and orange upper face remain recognizable, but the lower face and mask boundary shear in attack and become jagged in death. Independent anatomical patches confirm source and battle drift around 0.53; unresolved pending candidate review. Navy tunic, gloves, legs, boots and raised orange tail remain continuous. Candidate targets measured cheek and lower-face drift, with a smooth transition into the mobile neck. Source geometry, textures, rig and curves must remain exact; independent probe, full-body geometry and actual candidate visual inspection required before promotion. Candidate v1 rejected for recoil mask transition edge stretch. V2 widens the vertical fade below the face.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle front/side head/body slices, 13 clips at six phases. Confirmed severe muzzle and chin stretching: the cream cheeks flatten and widen on downward nods and form an elongated black lower-face wedge when looking up during gallop, jump, attack, hit reaction and entrance. Source and battle independent face drift exceeds four. Long ears, forepaws, hind legs and curled tufted tail remain attached. Complete face repair required. Candidate targets measured cheek and lower-face drift, with a smooth transition into the mobile neck. Source geometry, textures, rig and curves must remain exact; independent probe, full-body geometry and actual candidate visual inspection required before promotion. Candidate v1 rejected: fade included raised forepaw and lower body vertices. V2 excludes vertices below -0.24 while fully locking the measured face above -0.22. V2 rejected for sharp lower-face transition. V3 spreads the measured fade over the neck and upper torso; geometry and visual body checks remain required. V3 rejected for two remaining forepaw transition warnings. V4 widens the depth fade while preserving full face anchoring.
All 13 original animations visually inspected in complete front/side head and body sheets. Meerkat cheek and lower muzzle flatten during turned defeat; lateral fade excludes raised hands.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged source/battle front/side head/body sheets, all 13 clips at six phases. Red eyes, gray crest and hooked yellow upper bill remain recognizable; wings can occlude the face without pulling it. The source black lower-bill/root patch still fails independent anatomy sampling (0.034967 drift), although the battle mesh passes and the distortion is subtle in the sheets. Four source vertices retain non-head influences around the lower bill and jaw. Source repair required before approval; navy scarf, red belt, wings, legs, talons and tail remain continuous.
